_about: Generation models the editor may call. Every id, input and limit the code uses lives here; the generate skill reads `gen.py models`. Checked against docs.higgsfield.ai (openapi.json v2.0.0 and the model pages) on 2026-10-17; prices come from the estimate endpoint at run time, never from this file.

higgsfield.name: Higgsfield
higgsfield.concurrency_note: Concurrency depends on the account; over it the API answers 400 'Maximum number of concurrent requests'.

higgsfield/genjutsu/motion-transfer/v1.0.name: Genjutsu motion transfer
higgsfield/genjutsu/motion-transfer/v1.0.use: Puts the motion of a clip of the user's footage onto 1-8 reference images (a character, a product, a styled version of them).

kling-video/v2.5-turbo/pro/text-to-video.name: Kling 2.5 Turbo Pro, text to video
kling-video/v2.5-turbo/pro/text-to-video.use: B-roll from a sentence: a shot the user did not film.

kling-video/v2.5-turbo/pro/image-to-vide.name: Kling 2.5 Turbo Pro, image to video
kling-video/v2.5-turbo/pro/image-to-vide.use: Animates a still (a frame of the user's video, a product photo, a screenshot) into a short shot.

kling-video/v2.5-turbo/standard/image-to.name: Kling 2.5 Turbo Standard, image to video
kling-video/v2.5-turbo/standard/image-to.use: The cheaper image-to-video: drafts and quick b-roll.

minimax/hailuo-2.3/standard/text-to-vide.name: Hailuo 2.3 Standard, text to video
minimax/hailuo-2.3/standard/text-to-vide.use: B-roll from a sentence, 6 or 10 s.

higgsfield-ai/soul/standard.name: Soul, text to image
higgsfield-ai/soul/standard.use: A still for a card or as the first frame of an image-to-video shot.
